title: Four doors read an id raw instead of through the thread door, so events --subject 94 finds nothing where ST0094 finds its events
body:
Found by vc's Highlander sweep for ST0095 (report B, cluster D5, banked at refs/bank/vc/st0095/highlander-B-rust-rest-20261119), and the first point driven by ic on brew 3.4.0 on 2026-11-19.

`thread_spec` (render.rs:16187) is the one door that reads a thread id, and four operator doors bypass it:

- `events --subject` (render.rs:8484, mcp.rs:1778) filters by string equality (facade.rs:7138). Driven: `intent events --subject ST0094` lists ST0094's events, and `intent events --subject 94` answers "no event matches this filter", which is a wrong answer, since 94 is ST0094 at every other door.
- `todo done` (render.rs:9345) passes the raw value to `scope_of`, so `todo done 56/02` fails where `wp done 56/02` works; `todo notdone` and `todo toggle` (render.rs:9313) do the same.
- `ac descope --to` (render.rs:3478, mcp.rs:994) compares the target by string equality (facade.rs:17277).
- MCP's `ac list`, `at list` and `at lint` drop the `/NN` (mcp.rs:923, 1020, 1025), where the CLI arms pass it to the facade as part of the thread id (render.rs:3431, 3669, 3716).

ST0095 WP-10 fixes all four by taking every door through the waist's operator reader.
